snippet.title: Doobie First Look Gameplay
snippet.description:
Doobie
A horror game by FiX Studios

Status: 🧪 Early Access (🎮 Singleplayer only – 🔗 LAN Multiplayer coming soon!)

Welcome to Doobie – a twisted cartoon horror where laughter fades and panic sets in. 💡😱

You’ve woken up in a locked room. The power’s unstable, the air is heavy… and something is in there with you. 👁️
The Doobie—or Doobies—are hunting. They’re unpredictable, relentless, and just plain weird. 🐾

Armed only with your flashlight 🔦, you must search for a hidden 🔑 that randomly spawns in one of five locations.
It’s your only way out—but time is against you.

Scattered around the map are objects you can use to defend yourself:
📦 Box
🛢️ Barrel
🧯 Fire Extinguisher
Each one can be thrown to stun or slow down the Doobies—if you're quick enough to grab them.

Get caught? You're done. No checkpoints. No mercy. Back to the start. 💀

🔥 Current Features:
☠️ Survive against 1–3 Doobies (higher count = harder challenge)

🔦 Start with a flashlight to light your way through the dark

🗝️ Escape by finding the randomly placed key

📦 Three throwable objects (more coming soon!)

🎮 Full controller support

🧍‍♂️ Solo gameplay (LAN multiplayer on the way)

👻 Cartoon horror style with a dark, surreal twist

🧩 Roadmap:
🧪 Playable demo dropping soon on itch.io

🧠 If players dig it, a Steam demo with LAN support will follow

🕸️ Full version planned for 2026 with complete multiplayer support

🖥️💻📱 Launch platforms: Steam, iOS, Microsoft Store ($3–5), and Android (📲 Free with ads)

🕷️ Creepy. Offbeat. Unpredictable.
Doobie is the kind of horror that sneaks up on you—then laughs when you scream.
